text:
carla: FINCO wants to run a 2-week POC in a sealed datacenter next Mon. They specifically asked: upgrade cadence during POC, bundle signing/verification, and pricing for reserved capacity while in the POC. Can we put together a short one-pager and any ops constraints?

mike: We can support this. For air-gapped: two main options — full immutable bundles (easiest) or delta bundles (smaller transfers but more tooling). POC: recommend full bundles for first run to keep rollback simple.

anna: Security checklist bits: need SBOM, signed bundles, offline verification, and an HSM/KMS integration for final key wrapping. Also they'll want evidence of patch cadence and CVE process. I can add the required questionnaire bits.

jason: From solutions side, acceptance criteria we usually send:
- smoke (API responds, inference sanity)
- perf (p95 latency < 300ms at 1rps)
- stability (24h no OOMs)
- upgrade test (apply next bundle without data loss)

priya: I'll draft a POC checklist. Quick sample acceptance test steps:
1) Place signed bundle on jumpbox and run:
```bash
redwood-agent install --bundle ./redwood-bundle-v1.tar.gz --verify-signature
```
2) Start inference and run 100 sample prompts through the test harness.
3) Run upgrade: install v1.0.1 bundle and verify traffic continues.
```bash
redwood-agent upgrade --bundle ./redwood-bundle-v1.0.1.tar.gz
```
4) Verify logs for KV cache warmup and no tokenization errors.

carla: Anna — what about cert rotation during an air-gapped POC? Customer worried about key expiry mid-eval.

anna: Short answer: we recommend a local CA with a >6mo validity for POC and an out-of-band rotation plan. If they want automated rotation we need the jumpbox to be able to talk to a KMS or have an HSM appliance. Document that.

jason: Pricing note for sales: Offer a POC reserved pool discount (suggest 40% off month 1 + waived onboarding). If they convert to Dedicated, commit months apply. Need finance signoff but that's our standard playbook.

sarah: Legal: we'll need their DPA + execution on our POC SOW. Also add clause for offline bundle acceptance and retention of signed SBOMs for compliance.

mike: Ops constraints:
- offline bundle size cap recommendation: keep < 5GB for jumpbox transfer speed
- if delta bundles enabled, need coordinator node to apply deltas (extra ops work)
- rollback: keep previous full bundle available, and snapshot of model weights.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: build #1234 completed for redwood-bundle-v1 (sha256:abc123). Artifacts stored at s3://redwood-artifacts/prod/1234 (internal link).

carla: Perfect. I'm going to assemble a one-pager: POC checklist, security items (from Anna), acceptance criteria (Jason/ Priya), and pricing bullet (Jason). Will ping finance and legal for final wording.

priya: I can be on the kickoff call Wed 10am to walk through install steps and checklist.

anna: I'll attach the minimal security answers we typically share for POCs (SBOM template + offline keywrap steps) — will paste into the doc.

carla: Thanks everyone — will post draft docs in this thread before sending to FINCO. :thumbsup:
